title: Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma! II
description: Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma! II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Scared Lass

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma and the 3 Heroes in the Pinata Standoff that randomly appears off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Then return to the Scared Lass in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Scared Lass

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma and the 3 Heroes in the Pinata Standoff that randomly appears off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Then return to the Scared Lass in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

You know what, it might not just be the evil spirit that scares me. In the stories my dah tells me the evil pinata spirit has three evil Heroes that protect him and they sound really scary so maybe they are also the reason I'm so scared. Can you kill them and the evil spirit to see if I won't be scared any more?

Go to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and it might magically take you to the Pinata Showdown. If it does, kill the three evil Heroes and the evil pinata spirit, Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma. When you have done this return to me, the Scared Lass, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Did you kill them? I can't really tell... nope, judging from the puddle at my feet I'm still really really scared. There must still be some out there somewhere.

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata Antiguo del Fantasma on Level 2
  • Destroy the Three Evil Heroes on Level 2

Level range: 80–100
